<strong>ILO1</strong> — Giải thích vai t: ILO1 — Explain the role of forecasting in the planning system (S&OP → MPS → MRP), distinguish demand, forecast, plan and target, and choose the right forecasting level for each decision.
<strong>ILO2</strong> — Chuẩn bị dữ liệu: ILO2 — Prepare demand data: detect errors and noise (stock-outs, end-of-period loading, returns, code changes, unit errors), restore unconstrained demand and keep an auditable adjustment log.
<strong>ILO3</strong> — Xây dựng dự báo: ILO3 — Build baseline forecasts (Naive, MA, SES, Holt) and evaluate them out of sample with suitable metrics (WMAPE, Bias, MASE), including by forecast lag.
<strong>ILO4</strong> — Mô hình hóa mùa: ILO4 — Model seasonality, the Tết calendar effect, price and promotions; separate baseline from uplift and assess the financial return of promotions.
<strong>ILO5</strong> — Thiết kế chính s: ILO5 — Design portfolio-level forecasting policies (ABC/XYZ, intermittent demand, aggregate levels) and select models on out-of-sample evidence.
<strong>ILO6</strong> — Vận hành Demand: ILO6 — Run a Demand Review: bring in information from every department, measure FVA and Tracking Signal, set adjustment rules and challenge with evidence.
<strong>ILO7</strong> — Chuyển dự báo th: ILO7 — Turn the forecast into operational decisions: safety stock from out-of-sample error, in-month early warning, shelf-life risk, capacity checks and value conversion for S&OP.
<strong>ILO8</strong> — Thực hiện trọn m: ILO8 — Complete a full monthly forecasting cycle, present an S&OP recommendation with trade-offs and hand over the unconstrained demand plan to Production Planning.
